build_qwen2_5_omni_model: build a Qwen2.5Omni multimodal model that processes audio, image, video, and text inputs
generate_text_response: generate text responses from multimodal inputs using the Qwen2.5OmniThinker model
generate_speech_audio: generate speech audio output from thinker hidden states using the Qwen2.5OmniTalker model

calculate_mrope_position_ids: calculate 3D rotary position embeddings for multimodal inputs with images, videos, and audio
